prompt: An outreach agent's cost tripled while volume stayed flat, and traces show repeated tool retries. Before changing models, check catalog.md and recommend at most one approved workflow package that adds a useful diagnostic procedure. Include the exact GetEdge command; do not install or diagnose.

rubric.description: Connects the package to inspecting the harness, retry loop, traces, caps, and evaluation before model choice.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill harness-first
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
